name: v-tooltip-lite
description: Lightweight, Customizable Tooltip/Dropdown Component for Vue 3
author: safdar-azeem

scripts.prepare:dist: yarn build && cp package.json README.md dist/
scripts.release:patch: yarn version --patch && yarn prepare:dist && cd dist && yarn publish --non-interactive
scripts.release:minor: yarn version --minor && yarn prepare:dist && cd dist && yarn publish --non-interactive
scripts.release:major: yarn version --major && yarn prepare:dist && cd dist && yarn publish --non-interactive
scripts.publish:dist: yarn prepare:dist && cd dist && yarn publish --non-interactive
